nom: No7 Restore & Renew Face & Neck Multi Action Serum

avis.texte: I am on my 3rd tube of this serum, and the 4th is in my linen closet for when I'm done with my 3rd. I bought this serum in Ulta when I finished my last tube of a discontinued serum. I had no idea if I would like it, but I needed a serum, so I thought, shy not give this a try. I've been hooked ever since. A little goes a long way, and it goes on like creamy silk. My skin looks smooth and refreshed, My neck has also shown improvement. I am 73 years old and have always taken care of my skin, and this product is certainly a keeper (I've tried many over the years). A little goes a long way, and Ulta has so many savings promotions, you can stock up and save a bundle.

avis.titre: I buy this product many times
avis.texte: I love how this product makes my skin feel refreshed and smooth

I bought this face serum, as I ran out of my old time favorite, which is no longer being made. It just so happened that my hairdresser mentioned No7, so I thought I would try it. So far, so good. Goes on beautifully, and my face looks & feels great.

avis.titre: Little serum that goes a long way
avis.texte: This product may not look so big but you only need to use a couple dabs on your face and neck which spreads and absorbs in the skin smoothly!
This serum has done absolutely nothing to reduce my wrinkles!!! All cosmetic companies promise miracles that never materialize!!! Truth in advertising??? I think not!!!

It didn't take me long to start seeing a difference on my neck not that it was bad to begin with as I am doing it more for preventative reasons, im 29 for reference/background, but I do see a difference. The product itself is really nice, absorbs really well, doesn't have a smell or anything, And is lightweight enough for the daytime too!

I got the product for free in exchange for writing the review Its consistency is smooth and lightweight, which allows for easy application and quick absorption without leaving a greasy residue. Unlike some other products, this serum feels gentle on the skin and has not caused any irritation or breakouts. The formula seems to be well-balanced, offering hydration and firmness without feeling too heavy. It provides excellent hydration, leaving the skin feeling soft and supple. Regular use has noticeably improved the firmness and elasticity of my skin. Its effectiveness in improving skin texture and appearance justifies its value, and it has become a staple in my skincare routine.
This product was AMAZING! Very smooth and soft to my skin. Beautiful color and radiance to my skin now. i highly reccommend this product! Restor & Renew is the best!
I've been using this product for weeks now every day and I see absolutely no difference at all.

I received No7 Restore and Renew Face & Neck Multi-Action Serum complimentary in exchange for my honest review. I have really started to like the No7 brand and it's products. This Multi-Action Face and Neck Serum has been a staple in my nighttime skin care regimen for the last 3 weeks. I like the fact that I get multiple benefits from a single product. As I age, I have noticed my skin losing the elasticity and firmness that it once had. The fine lines beginning around my eyes, forehead, and at my smile creases. My skin tone is not as uniform as it once was either. The years of UV damage and leaving my make up on overnight has definitely left its marks on my skin. But since I have been using Restore & Renew, my skin has become firmer, tighter, softer, and less blotchy looking. The fine lines around my eyes and smile lines are smoothing out and less visible than they used to be a month ago. My skin also feels very hydrated when I wake up in the morning and it lasts throughout my day. . The only thing that is a downfall for me is the thickness of the serum. It is thicker than my usual serums that I use. With having an oily complexion, I tend to gravitate to the lighter, more liquid serums. Restore & Renew Serum is more of a lotion type serum that is a little heavier on my skin and it leaves my skin looking shiny and oily. That is why I only use it at night. I love all of the positive results that I have seen and felt, so much so, that I will keep this as my nighttime serum. It h

I received this product as part of a free sample program. I love the No7 brand and this Restore & Renew Face & Neck Multi-Action Serum is a great addition to my beauty routine. It says it has benefits such as, "wrinkles appear visibly reduced", "skin tone looks more even", and "neck looks visibly smoother and feels noticeably firmer." So far, I have been really happy with the product and the results I have seen and feel. As we get into summer, and the humidity where I live increases, I do have to limit using this to once a day or once every other day, in order to limit blemishes. Overall, I'm happy to add this to my beauty routine.
Love No7 products! I use Restore and Renew Face and Neck Serum daily! The wrinkles keep diminishing.

Serum performed as advertised. Upon receiving my free product, I used it twice per day after thoroughly cleansing and toning my face and neck. My face felt hydrated and moisturized without and heavy oils or residue. After having used the serum for four weeks, I'm impressed. My skin feels firmer and looks healthier. I would definitely purchase and recommend No.7 Serum to others.

avis.titre: NO#7 Face & Neck multi action serum
avis.texte: It's very easy too understand the instructions and takes no more 20 minutes of your time to fill the card out

I received this product from a sampling program. It made the skin on my face and neck more smoother. I had bumpy skin on my jawline on both sides and after 3 weeks of use the bumps are going away. This is the first product I have tried that actually accomplished this.

avis.titre: Love and will be adding to my routine!
avis.texte: From the very first time I used this, there was a noticeable difference from other serums. It felt soft (I swear I've never considered anything in my skin care line up soft!), lightweight, and a little went a long way! I received this as a gift for a review and I will def buy more when this runs out!

Después de lavar mi cara todas la mañanas, me aplico el producto y fue sorprendente como en menos de siete días se noto la diferencia, ahora mi piel luce hidratada y mi más manchas están bajando su pigmentación.

No7 Restore & Renew kindly gave me this Face & Neck Serum for free so that I could review it. I love the product! The fine wrinkle lines in my forehead and laugh lines in my cheeks are less noticeable after using this serum for just 30 days. It has a nice scent, didn't irritate my skin, and isn't too thin so it covers the area well. I would definitely recommend No7 Restore & Renew Face & Neck Serum to anyone looking to make fine lines and wrinkles a little less noticeable!

avis.titre: Definitely a new addition to my routine
avis.texte: I used the number 7 restore & renew face and neck serum for the ask amount of time and I absolutely have fell in love with. It has left my skin feeling so refreshed and renewed, even more young feeling and looking in my opinion…! I will be purchasing this when mine runs out as it has already been added to my daily routine.

I've been using this product for about a month now. My face has an instant glow and looks amazing. It has a nice subtle smell. I personally wouldn't say it made my skin feel firmer but it did make it look smoother. Overall I liked the product and would recommend.
I use it morning and night to help with firmness and smooth skin. It ain't botox but it's pretty darn good!

After using this product for 30 days, I can definitely see and feel the improvement in my skin! I received this product free for my honest review. No 7 Restore and Renew has softened the wrinkles on my face and neck. It absorbs completely into my skin. I used it day and night! Not too heavy and the scent is mild and pleasant. Definitely recommend!
Restore and renew face lotion I used it for 2 weeks and while I did not notice a dramatic change, my skin felt smoother and very hydrated, highly recommended

I received this product part of a free sample program. I only used this product daily for 30 days. I did notice a small difference especially on my neck. It made my face feel soft and clean. I would purchase this product but would probably add their other products to hopefully produce even better w

avis.titre: Better Looking Skin For The Win
avis.texte: So pleased I received this as part of a Free Sample program. I had not used this line before, but since receiving/using No7 Restore & Renew, I've added the day cream to my regime. The one two punch these products are providing to the texture and firmness of my skin, especially in the neck area are amazing.

I received this product as part of a free sample program so I was unsure of what to expect. I usually use higher end skincare products but I would say this is on par with the best of them. I can't say that I have noticed visible tightening of my face and neck but this is a beautiful serum that glides smoothly on my combination skin and absorbs well and leaves my skin feeling very smooth and silky. It performs well under makeup. The only thing is the size is very small to be advertised for use for the face and neck. If I didn't know what it was for I would assume it was an eye cream. There's not enough product to last very long in my opinion. The other thing is that it is very heavily fragranced so if you are sensitive to fragrance or don't like florals you may want to reconsider. If there was more product I might consider purchasing but I don't think it's worth the value for the price unfortunately. I received this product as part of a free sample program.

I received this product as part of a free sampling program, and boy and I'm glad I did. I used it in the morning on clean skin and again after washing my face at night before bed. It is simple to use. I love the container that dispenses just enough. It slides on my face easily and has a fresh scent. But the best part is that IT WORKS! My skin looks tighter, firmer, less wrinkly, and less flakey. I expected some flakes because of the pro-retinol, but my skin actually looks more hydrated and smoother than before. I'm sold on this product. It works better than some I've tried that cost way more. I will definitely be buying this from now on.

avis.titre: Now a staple in my skincare routine
avis.texte: I've been using this serum for a couple of weeks and really like it. I use in AM and PM before moisturizer. My fine lines seem less defined and my face and neck are smoother. The serum is a nice thick texture that feels smooth and powdery when applying. I haven't had any interactions with my other skincare products.

I used this for over two weeks and noticed that my neck feels more moisturized. I didn't see any noticeable improvement on my skin although I used it consistently daily. I also noticed a rash on the lower right side of my neck. I stopped using it and the rash healed. I am not sure if this is something that works for me.

avis.titre: A welcome addition to my routine. Must have.
avis.texte: Wow! What a difference in just a few days! Skin is brighter and tighter. No greasy feel. I highly recommend if you are looking for a glow up in your skin. Mid 40's dull skin was a problem until I added this miracle product!

This product absolutely works to reduce the appearance of wrinkles and gives a smoother look to skin contributing to a more youthful look. It can be used under make-up and I had no skin irritation or issues while using this product. Definitely recommend and this product has become apart of my morning and night facial care routine.

I use the serum in the morning and evening before moisturizing. I make sure to leave time in between products so serum has the chance to absorb to feel and see full benefit. I do notice firmer face and neck but not wrinkle reduction. I think with more time ill be able to see results.

avis.titre: Definitely adding this to my skincare routine
avis.texte: I was shocked to see this product do as much as it has. I have been receiving chemotherapy and my skin has been so very dry and itchy. This serum has not only hydrated my face and neck but made quite a noticeable difference and helped to heal a few spots. I would typically break out with new products, not see, or feel much difference and feel as if I've wasted my money. My deep lines have gotten much better and I've seen my face have more of a youthful glow and plumpness to it. I think it's important to note that I have quite a few neck and chest tattoos that also look much better. I love that it is lightweight and smells quite pleasant also. I very much recommend this product and will continue to use it!
I added this product to my night and day skincare routine. The texture was nice and had a pleasant scent. I felt the firming action in the 1st use. Overall, my skin felt healthier. I would buy again!

I recieved this product in exchange for my honest review. I've never tried this brand before but so glad I did. This serum is super hydrating! I was lucky to recieve this 2 days after I had a medical grade chemical peel. I was shedding like a snake when this arrived. I started using this twice a day and it really helped speed up the healing process from the peel. This left my face silky smooth. There was zero greasiness after applying! There is a fragrance that some might find unappealing but I loved it. Definitely recommend this product to my friends with mature skin.

I prefer a simple skincare routine, with multitasking products. My skin is sensitive & combination, & reactive to perimenopausal hormone changes. This product tackles several environmental & age related skin concerns in a light, fully absorbed serum. In the warmer months, I find that I don't need to layer an additional moisturizer. I received this product as part of a sample program, but will purchase another tube soon.

After tring this product for just a couple days as part of being a Bzz agent, I already noticed brighter and smoother skin. It is light and not greasy. It smells great. I am starting to notice firmer skin on my neck after just a couple weeks. I tried this for free in exchange for writing a review but I will definitely be purchasing this to become part of my regular skin routine!

I received this product for free in return for my honest review and I love it. It makes my skin feel soft and smooth. No greasy feeling and improves the look of the skin on my neck and face. Will definitely keep using. Highly recommend!
I love how soft and smooth my skin feels. I do see a difference in my fine lines. They look smoother. I do like this product and will be repurchasing!

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I wish I would have taken a "before" picture, because then I would have known for sure if the product worked after 30 days use. I do believe some of my wrinkles have been erased and I can see that my skin looks smoother. I will buy this product again when my free sample is gone. I have never tried a product like this before, and I am glad that I tried it.

avis.titre: High-priced results in a moderately-priced package
avis.texte: This product that I received from No7 in trade for a fair review has exceeded my expectations. I knew of the brand, but this was my first use of No7. I did see some smoothing of my neck lines when I used it in the morning, but it truly excelled as a primer and base for my makeup in the morning. Using it both morning and night, I do plan to purchase more of this serum, as it was pleasant to use and effective. I do not think the fragrance was too strong or overdone, it absorbed quickly, and worked well with the products I already use. I am now very curious about the other options in this Restore & Renew line!!

avis.titre: #7 neck cream I would recommend  this product for all your s
avis.texte: I use this neck cream day and night. I absolutely love it. Highly recommended. It helps soften up my neckline.

I received this product in exchange for an honest review. I read the instructions prior to using and it's recommended to use with the renew and restore day and night serum but I used with my own day and night creams. I'm sure you'd get even better results by using it all together. I don't like getting products with strong smells that result in a headache and this product is a little on the stronger side but it didn't give me a headache. There is a slight fragrance but it's pleasant. I've been using this for almost a month; day and night after washing my face and before any other products. The serum was so smooth, like butter.. I used a couple of drops and used all over my face, neck and back of my hands (don't forget the back of hands) I can say after DAY 1 my skin was glowing. I am showing a before, right after and now picture. I definitely think it filled in some fine lines. Other than the fragrance the price point can be high if you buy the .05 Oz vs. the 1 Oz. It's priced fairly (although I didn't buy it I did my research). Definitely 8/10 for me!

avis.titre: Silky feeling serum that creates radiance
avis.texte: I love using this serum. It feels so silky on my face and neck and absorbs easily without feeling greasy or heavy. It has a light fragrance that smells really nice. I've been using it daily and it makes my skin look radiant and healthy. The fine lines around my eyes are becoming less noticeable the longer that I'm using it. I use it in the morning as part of my daily routine before using a moisturizer and it really has made a difference. I received a free sample to review.
I love this stuff! My skin feels so smooth a d soft. And it smells great

I tried this serum on my face and neck for a week and I had very good results! My complexion was definitely brighter and not dull looking as it was before using the serum. My skin was also firmer. The serum has a very nice smell to it which I liked. This serum is very easy to apply and use. I really like it and I will continue using this serum from No7! I would definitely recommend it for anyone to try! I did receive this product as part of a free sample program.

avis.titre: Love how this feels on the skin
avis.texte: This product is amazing. The consistency is silky to the touch and once applied to face it instantly softens skin and blurs imperfections. It's truly amazing how silky sift it makes your skin feel. A little goes a long way to so don't over apply. Can also be used on the backs of hands and neck area to smooth skin and create a more youthful appearance!

This is an amazing serum. It is very lightweight and absorbs into the skin easily. It has a nice mild scent to it. I have noticed over the past few weeks that my skin has changed. It is much smoother and looks more youthful.

avis.titre: I needed this!  You should try it too!
avis.texte: Needed this for my neck and it works so well for firming up the skin, I love this serum!

I have tried many serums in my years from expensive brands and Restore & Renew Face & Neck Multi Action Serum is better than the majority of those. I saw results within a week of using it. Restore & Renew Face & Neck Multi Action Serum was sent to me in exchange for my honest review. I have used it twice daily as instructed for a month now and I am very pleased with the results. My pores have become smaller and the texture and tone of my face have improved a lot. My skin is firmer on my face and my neck. My wrinkles have softened. I like it so much that I have already purchased more. Needless to say I am done paying for expensive brands. This is my first No.7 product and I'm excited to try more of the anti-aging line.

avis.titre: I would add this serum to my skin care routine
avis.texte: I've been using No 7 Restore & Renew Face & Neck Multi Action Serum for about a month now. I've found this serum to be a nice lightweight consistency, similar to a gel lotion. It applies and absorbs nicely into my skin. It is not greasy, sticky nor tacky. It makes your skin feel soft and smoother, similar to using a primer. As far as visibly reducing the look of lines and wrinkles though, I can't say that I notice any difference, but I did like the product and would add it to my skin care routine.

I used the produce over a course of a month so far. My skin was bumping and rough when I started. After a week my skin had soaked up the wonderful cream and became luxurious and tight. After 2 weeks I was hooked and my turkey neck had disappeared and become a lonely long swan neck. Now I started Working my way down to my decalata. Making a smoother and less wrinkled nexk and chest.
Great product! Love the texture and results in smoothing out of fine lines and wrinkles!

After using No 7 Restore and Renew Multi Action Face and Neck Serum I noticed firmer and smoother skin. I used morning and night. I was surprised at how fast it worked. This serum is a blend of hyaluronic acid and peptides and is very nourishing to your skin,
While I really liked the texture of this serum it had an unpleasant smell that I just couldn't get over. I feel like it does what it claims though.

I really liked how easy it spread on my skin leaving my skin soft and hydrated with a nice glow. I didn't really like the scent although it dissipated pretty quickly. Overall I didn't see much of a difference on my skin using this product.

I am starting to notice smoothness around my forehead already. It's very gentle. I love the way it feels on my neck. It's . Something about it makes me feel refreshed. I have a feeling this will be an IT product for me!

I received this product as part of a free sample program. I love how soft and smooth it makes my face feel. The scent is a nice clean refreshing scent. I felt it immediately soften and moisturize my skin. I have used similar products and this seems to work the best. Only a little will do.

The Restore & Renew serum is a great product to use on your face and neck to help keep it moisturized, it helps smooth out your skin and feels so soft when using this amazing product, I love using it on a daily basis and will continue to use it more and definitely do recommend this product to anyone else.

I received the No. 7 Face and Neck Serum in return for my honest opinion. This product worked well on my neck wrinkles. It was easy to get out of the tube and absorbed easily into my skin. It didn't leave a greasy residue like some creams do. My skin felt smooth to the touch after applying the product. I saw a difference in my neck after about two weeks of using it nightly. You don't need a lot of the product, just a little dab will work to cover your neck and or problem area. There is a strong perfume smell so if scents bother you, keep that in mind. I will continue to use this product since it is working well for me.

No7 definitely keeps up to its brand reputation. This cream did wonders for my face. My face and neck felt so much smoother and fresher. I definitely feel my skin is getting tighter and wrinkles are less visible. This comes in a push tube packing. The cream is almost serum kinds, it's very light on the skin, so it gets absorbed on the face and neck really fast. The smell is very soft . It keeps skin hydrated for the whole day. I use it at Am and PM. Definitely love it and can't wait to see long term impact.

I highly recommend this brand and product goes on smooth smells good. Works fast your skin feels and looks tighter and smooth. I got this for free from bzzagent to try for my honestopinion. It past the test !!!

avis.titre: I will absolutely purchase this product
avis.texte: I've received this product free from a sample review program I will definitely purchase more of it.

I found the Boots No. 7 to be my go to after receiving it. Compliments of Bzz agent. I used it for the two weeks to see the best results and I did. It applied beautifully and left my skin smooth and soft. My makeup applied easily and effortlessly after using. My fine lines around my mouth and eyes seem to have diminished. My neck lines seem to appear lighter as well. Boots No. 7 face and neck serum is a must have in your skincare routine. I'll never be without this product now that I've tried it.

This serum absorbs quickly into my skin. There's no stickiness, and no harsh smell. It's a multi action serum for the face and neck. It's best to use after washing your face in the am and during the pm.

I find this No. 7 Face and Neck serum to be gentle. My skin had no negative reaction to using it twice a day. It does seem to be hydrating. I like the blend of ingredients. It's very nice to apply, feels very smooth. It does contain fragrance, which I kinda like, but others may not. The tube is kind of small, so if you're using it twice a day, trying to see the results it boasts, you will go through it rather quickly. Although I enjoyed using it and it made my skin feel soft and hydrated, I did not notice much, if at all, firming. This may be a product that needs more than just a month to see such results, although it gives lesser timeframe for visible results.

avis.titre: I love this product and I'm so happy that I received it
avis.texte: I'm a stay home now!!. I love love this product in jusI love staying fresh looking,as well as this really works.I highly recommend this product!!

I received this product as part of a sampling program. I'm so happy I did! My skin is softer and smoother. The fine lines that I have are less now. I was skeptical but this No. 7 has won me over. Has a non-greasy feel and a wonderful scent. Also you don't need a lot to cover your face and neck so it will last quite a while.

Although I received the serum in exchange for a review, I genuinely love it! I noticed a difference in my skin after just a few uses. It helps with skin tone, clarity, and smooths out the skin! I will continue to purchase this serum and recommend it to everyone!
I will definitely be repurchasing. It works. I saw a noticeable difference in the loose skin on my neck.
The product has shown excellent results at a manageable price point. Such a shame how most good products out there are not affordable. This one is different! Very pleased.

Product indicates suitable for sensitive skin. Caused irritation on my neck & around my eyes. Woke up with the area under my eyes red and very swollen. My neck has raised bumps along with patches of redness. Be careful if you have sensitive skin.

avis.auteur: Please do include my last name or email
avis.titre: No 7 is always my favorite product to buy.
avis.texte: The serum and moisturizer are a great combination for me. They have always kept my skin nourished and the SPF 30 broad spectrum sunscreen it contains is an added bonus.
The product is very smooth and shows the beneficial ingredients when applied to my face. Thank you.
I have been using Serum No. 7 for years! I highly recommend it.
I've been using No. 7 products for years, so I thought this would work as well. I used it a couple of times, until I woke up with my eyes SWOLLEN!! One was swollen shut, I will stick to what I know.
I was looking for a serum that didn't leave my face feeling sticky. This stuff absorbs quickly, leaving only a soft supple glow. No more dry patches or dark spots. And my sensitive skin loves it!

avis.titre: I'm one of the sensitive ones
avis.texte: I was excited to try this neck cream after it was featured in a magazine's top neck creams. It says "safe for sensitive skin" and, foolish me, I believed it and skipped the patch test. I started itching on day two and had a bright red rash. So, it went back. If you have sensitive skin it might work for you but do the patch test!

Nice texture. I use it night and day. when putting makeup over it it can pill so you just need to be gentle. It works amazing. I stopped using it for a month or two only because I forgot and wow what a difference. I don't forget anymore, lol. Definitely tightens the skin.
I love the way my skin feels after applying. I do see a change in my skin tone akso
This product REALLY works!! Sagging skin on my neck tightens and goes back in place. The results were noticed immediately.
It goes on easy and is quite refreshing. I'll buy another to keep in my gym bag.
I like the product but would prefer it unscented. I do not care for the smell.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: This product is inexpensive and does a better job than the expensive products that claim to do the same. It goes on beautifully and I see the effects. At 64, I have used many products. No 7 gives me the results I am looking for.

This is my go-to serum. It's light enough to put on prior to makeup, because it really absorbs and doesn't feel greasy (which is huge because I feel like a lot of products make my makeup look bad after a few hours). It also goes a long way and you actually get all the product out (I cut into everything when I can't squeeze it out anymore, and there's never any product left in the tube when I cut it open).

I noticed loose wrinkly skin on my neck a couple of months ago in some photos of me. Aging stinks! Since using this product, I've seen amazing results! The skin is much tighter looking, less wrinkly and appears more hydrated!

avis.titre: I am a religious user from now on ...
avis.texte: I use this product both day, and night after cleansing. Then, I apply No7 Renew Face & Neck Day Cream in the morning, then the same routine at night with the night cream. I can tell you that after like six months of use, the texture of my skin feels very different. And the smell? I love it! The smell is another reason I keep using it. I can't stand for my skin to smell after I sweat, so I live the scent No7 has to it. It's not strong, nor does it stink at all! I've smelled strong skin products, and this is nowhere compared to products like Olay, and the like. Boots No7 is the best there is scent wise. I know this because I was a faithful user of Olay starting from the age of 27 ending at age 49. It became way to harsh and I couldn't handle the strong scent anymore. At 50, this is my very favorite for sure. It picks up where Olay Regenerist left off.
I started using No. 7 products years ago. I have always taken good care of my skin and found No. 7 products did a great job at a reasonable price. Highly recommend!

I switched to No. 7 about six months ago, and I feel it is just as good, if not better, than more expensive brands. I used Strivectin for a few years or more, which is much more expensive. Their neck cream is supposed to the best neck cream, but I found it difficult to use with not much result. No. 7 is easy to use with better results.

avis.titre: If you have sensitive skin this is not for you
avis.texte: I have been using No7 protect and perfect serum for years, but I thought I would give this a try for more tightening of the skin. Well, after only two uses my skin got very puffy and my eyes were swollen. So I wouldn't recommend this if you have sensitive skin. I also didn't like the smell.

I have sensitive skin, so often I try a product that has great reviews only to find my skin saying "Nope!" I bought Restore & Renew Face & Neck Multi Action Serum primarily as a neck treatment. I loved the results that I was seeing so much that I started using it all over my face. I am seeing great results in fine lines and discoloration.

avis.titre: The serum feels light and smooth.
avis.texte: I like the feel of my skin after I apply the serum…soft and supple. I do not notice any reduction of lines and wrinkles or firming results.

My wife uses this product on a regular basis and I always purchase it for her at Ulta Beauty, whether it is on sale or not. I usually order it online and pick it up at the Sarasota, FL store, and this is very convenient for us.

I wish I could share a before and after picture! I've been using this for almost a year, typically once a day. A photo memory popped up today from 3 years ago with my turkey neck on full display. I took a picture today so I could compare. My neck looks 10 years younger today than it did 3 years ago. Amazing is all I can say.

I have tried a zillion things under the sun and nothing helps the lines on my neck - EXCEPT THIS! I use this in the morning after I wash my face and before I put on makeup, and again at night before I go to bed. I'm not even done with my first tube and have noticed a huge improvement. I don't feel confined to turtlenecks anymore!

I have tried to use this product several times, but end up with the same result: red, itchy skin. I think its reacting with other items that I'm currently using. Disappointed, as I love the way it feels on my skin.

Was really looking forward to trying this product after I read the reviews. Tried it on my neck for 2days, I now have swelling, itching and hives all over my neck. I have sensitive skin and thought this may work since it states it is safe for sensitive skin. Maybe it is for some, it was not for me:( Just wanted to give a heads up to any one else who may also have sensitive skin who are thinking of trying this serum. Definitely do a spot test. Really grateful I did not apply in my face.
